mapper.insert: INSERT INTO local_device_pairing_codes (user_id, code_hash, expires_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{codeHash}, #{expiresAt})
INSERT INTO local_device_capabilities (device_id, capability) VALUES (#{deviceId}, #{capability}) ON CONFLICT (device_id, capability) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT capability FROM local_device_capabilities WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} ORDER BY capability

SELECT id, name, platform, agent_version AS agentVersion, last_seen_at AS lastSeenAt, (revoked_at IS NULL AND last_seen_at >= #{onlineThreshold}) AS online FROM local_devices WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND revoked_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC
